description: This Java class 'InvestorBusinessEventSerializer' handles serialization of 'InvestorBusinessEvent' objects into Avro format, particularly for loan ownership transfer events. It involves converting event data into schema-compliant Avro objects, retrieving transfer data, and handling custom data serialization logic.

classes.name: InvestorBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class converting 'InvestorBusinessEvent' objects into Avro schema format, handling transfer data extraction, data transformation, and custom data incorporation for event messaging.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a 'BusinessEvent' to its Avro DTO representation, assembling data from transfer details and loan charges.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if a given 'BusinessEvent' is an 'InvestorBusinessEvent' suitable for this serializer.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the supported Avro schema class: 'LoanOwnershipTransferDataV1'.

methods.name: getExternalEventCustomDataSerializers
methods.description: Provides the list of custom data serializers used during serialization.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the string type ('BUYBACK', 'INTERMEDIARYSALE', or 'SALE') based on the transfer status.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Converts transfer status into corresponding string representation, handling 'EXECUTED', 'DECLINED', 'CANCELLED', or 'UNKNOWN'.

methods.name: getTransferStatusReason
methods.description: Returns the name of the transfer sub-status or null if none.

methods.name: getCurrencyFromEvent
methods.description: Extracts currency information from the event's loan data into an Avro 'CurrencyDataV1' object.

methods.name: getUnpaidChargeData
methods.description: Generates a list of 'UnpaidChargeDataV1' objects from loan charges with outstanding amounts.

methods.name: addToMap
methods.description: Associates unpaid charges with their total outstanding amounts in a map.
